purpose: Expose read-only lookup, reverse-reference, and bounded discovery CLI commands over the already-materialized Stage 1-4 indexes without reading raw ConfigData or creating new semantic relations.

cliPolicy.idLocatorMeaning: Return only Stage 1 source path/hash/container/recordIndex and optional copied discovery label; do not load the source record.
cliPolicy.forwardMeaning: Show only Stage 2 materialized direct edges whose sourceType equals the requested entity type.
cliPolicy.reverseMeaning: Show only Stage 3 materialized incoming references for the requested target type and ID.
cliPolicy.canonicalMeaning: Show the Stage 4 frozen canonical overlay attached to the requested entity ID as a separate section.

requiredChecks: all declared CLI input paths are materialized index paths rather than raw ConfigData paths
Stage 1 locator inputs have the expected entity/status and resolve sample IDs without reading source records
Stage 2 forward inputs have the expected domain/status and only same-sourceType direct edges are displayed
Stage 3 reverse inputs have the expected targetType/status and are addressed directly by target ID
Stage 4 overlay inputs have the expected domain/status and remain a separate canonical section
Soldier/Equipment find uses only the preserved Stage 1 discovery label with literal case-sensitive substring matching
CLI library exposes no transitive expansion, name JOIN, ID arithmetic, canonical recomputation, or write path
package scripts expose lookup, refs, find, Stage 5 build, and Stage 5 validation commands
regeneration produces a byte-identical Stage 5 summary

nextStage.goal: Add dependency-aware stale/source-hash checks and bounded incremental rebuild orchestration over the materialized lookup layers.
